headline: Carlos Slim's Grupo Carso Reports Strong Third-Quarter Profit Growth
summary: Mexican conglomerate Grupo Carso posted strong profit gains in the third quarter of 2026, according to its quarterly earnings presentation.
why: Grupo Carso is one of Mexico's largest industrial and commercial conglomerates, operating across retail, manufacturing, energy, and construction.

impacts.name: Grupo Carso SAB de CV
impacts.why: Stronger bottom-line profits validate operational efficiency and margin resilience across divisions.
